## Problem / user need
Who needs this, and what problem are they trying to solve?

## Proposed outcome
Describe the result, not just the implementation.

## User value
What measurable or practical improvement should this provide?

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ]
- [ ]

## Non-goals
What is explicitly outside this request?

## Dependencies and risks
List affected systems, data, security, accessibility, operations or external dependencies.

## Evidence / references
Add examples, research or relevant repository links. Do not include secrets or personal data.

## Approval considerations
Flag any material scope or architecture change, paid service, destructive action, hosted database migration or production deployment. These require explicit owner approval before action.
